name: BP Appointments - HHC Community Advisory Boards (CAB)
description:
This dataset lists appointments to New York City Health + Hospitals community advisory boards (CABs), covering five facilities: Kings County Hospital, Cumberland Diagnostic Center, Coney Island Hospital, Woodhull Hospital, and East New York Diagnostic and Treatment Center. Each row represents one board member or seat, with the person's first and last name, their role on the board (such as Chair, Vice Chair, Secretary, Treasurer, Executive Director, or a Borough President appointee), the length of their term, when the term took effect, and when it expires. A voting field indicates whether the member holds a voting seat, and some entries mark seats as vacant.

With about 90 rows and eight columns, the data is best suited for mapping board composition and leadership across facilities, identifying which seats are filled by Borough President appointees versus other roles, and tracking term start and expiration dates to spot upcoming vacancies or expired appointments. It can also support transparency and oversight work, such as comparing representation
